verdict.rationale: Official Gemini CLI documentation from the google-gemini GitHub org gives a dedicated guide to configuring and using MCP servers. Users register servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend the tool with new capabilities, which is first-party MCP-client support. The consumer app's Connected Apps feature is an adjacent integration and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP-client support in the main Gemini consumer app (only the CLI surface is documented), and independent or hands-on corroboration that plugged-in MCP tools work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: This document provides a guide to configuring and using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with Gemini CLI.
Configure MCP servers in `~/.gemini/settings.json` to extend Gemini CLI
